answer: Vertex-Disjoint Path Requirement.** Each agent identity must be reachable from the settlement core through vertex-disjoint routes whose count matches its claimed capacity tier, measured continuously by routing probes. Sybil clusters collapse onto shared relays, so declared capacity exceeding distinct-path support is throttled to the lowest tier. An attacker must fund separate relay infrastructure per identity, like kindling an ember per account, a cost that scales linearly and cannot be amortized. A single willow cannot bend into two paths.
